targets.outcome_quote: Despite the above divergence in ﬁndings, we believe that the theoretical grounds of the target paper remain relevant and that the replications are in support of the original theory and ﬁndings, as the replication results lend support for the main introspection hypothesis that self-other diﬀerences are larger for susceptibility to bias than for personal shortcoming.
